_what: Which predicates ask the SAME QUESTION. The service groups values within a family and refuses to group across anything not declared here. A predicate in no family is its own family of one. Ruled 2026-09-07 by Ryan.
_why: The ingests namespaced predicates by source (birth_date / pfa.birth_date / nflverse.birth_date / wikipedia.birth_date) to avoid pooling at ingest. The cost is that a man whose sources give two different birth days holds two single-valued predicates and nothing sees a disagreement: measured 2026-09-07, 2,417 men differ on the calendar day of birth and 105 on the day of death, invisible until the four predicates are read as one question.

_not_folded.hometown vs birth_place: where a man was FROM and where he was BORN are different facts. hometown, birthplace, pfa.birth_place and wikipedia.birth_place stay separate. Ruled 2026-09-07.
_not_folded.high_school: STAYS OUT, ruled 2026-09-07 by Ryan, with the reason recorded so nobody reopens it quietly: 'Central' and 'Central (Detroit, MI)' cannot be settled by a fold, and that shape is most of the 1,350 literal disagreements. Adding it would either invent agreement or record disagreements the archive cannot judge. It comes back when there is a real rule, not before.

draft.reading: src/readings.py draft -- year + round + overall pick; the club is not part of the reading
draft._draft_overall_pick_only_is_NOT_here: draft_picks_pre2001.csv has no round column, and draft.overall_pick_only exists to say so. Folding it into this family would pool a partial fact with complete ones -- the very thing the predicate name was created to prevent (gate_drafts D2). It stays its own family of one.
draft._wikipedia_draft_year_round_pick_are_NOT: three separate scalar fields, never assembled into a selection. A round on its own is not a draft pick.

college._pfa_college_season_is_NOT_here: pfa.college_season answers WHICH YEARS he attended, not which school. A different question.
college._ghosts: added 2026-09-08. Fenton's colleges were first written only inside the value dict of ghosts.roster_as_printed, so the family never saw them and the archive's first non-Neft disagreement was invisible to list_contested -- it existed only in a report. A disagreeing value is written as a CLAIM the family can see, or it is not held.

birth_place.ruled: Ryan, 2026-09-07, conditionally on the trailing-country fold being clean. Measured clean over all 2,874 pairs; see declarations/readings.json birth_place.
birth_place._hometown_is_still_NOT_here: where a man was FROM and where he was BORN are different facts. Ruled 2026-09-07 and unchanged.

death_place.ruled: Ryan, 2026-09-07, conditionally, as birth_place. Clean, and it collapses exactly one pair of 723.

_why_a_family_needs_a_reading: A family is what lets the model RECORD a disagreement; the reading is what stops it recording a false one. build_read_model.build_contested groups a value family by its declared reading where one exists, so RS-G6 has something to check and finds nothing -- rather than passing because the population is empty. Before 2026-09-07 only the two date families existed, and RS-G6 could not fire on any data the model could hold.
